blocks.text: [ K-IG 교육- principle08]
Principle: 8 After School/at Home
When I come home after school, my mother is always glad to see me.
I say, "Mom! I’m home," and then I take off my backpack
and wash my face and feet.
My mom replies, "How was your day?"
After I chat with my mom for a little while, I go to my room,
and I sometimes play on the computer.
After I play a little, I have to do all of my homework.
If I can’t figure out my homework, I can always look on the Internet.
I oftentimes find the answers to my assignments on the World Wide Web.
I get very tired quickly
because I have to do homework from both the academies and school.
Even though I am tired, I keep studying
because I enjoy learning new things.
Dinnertime is the only time that our family can get together the entire day.
Usually, my father comes home late,
so we can’t be together at suppertime.
Because my mother worries about the health of our family,
she prepares many different kinds of healthy side dishes.
My favorite food is bulgogi.
We always have great conversations at dinnertime.
We mostly talk about the interesting things
that happened to us during the day.
After dinner, our family watches TV together.
My mother doesn’t allow us to watch a lot of TV.
I like the entertainment programs because I can see famous actors
and musicians.
After I finish watching TV, I do a little review to prepare for school,
write in my journal, and then go to bed.
Even though my days are filled with many activities,
they are a lot of fun too.
